name: Fireflies MCP
description: Lets agents search and read Fireflies meeting transcripts, summaries, and action items over a hosted OAuth MCP server, and share or organize meetings.

skills.name: Transcript Search
skills.description: Queries meetings by keyword, date range, organizers, participants, or channel, and returns their metadata and summaries.

skills.name: Transcript Retrieval
skills.description: Fetches a full transcript with sentences, speakers, and timestamps, including a point-in-time snapshot of a live meeting.

skills.name: Meeting Summaries
skills.description: Fetches a meeting summary by ID with action items, keywords, and an overview, without the transcript content.

skills.name: Soundbite Clips
skills.description: Lists existing soundbites and creates new soundbite clips from a recorded meeting through the soundbite tools.

skills.name: Meeting Management
skills.description: Shares meetings, revokes meeting access, updates meeting titles, and moves meetings between channels.
